In 10 dimensions the crowds break into 32 tiny groups. On 2 components DBSCAN finds 4 clusters, the same number as K-Means.

Quest log: the 4 questions

How did PCA affect clustering?

XP rose from 0.237 to 0.449.

Did the picture get clearer?

Yes, in 2D, with a little overlap left.

Did we lose information?

Yes: we kept 48% and left 52% behind.

Which approach wins?

PCA: clearer clusters, worth the loss.
